items.resolution: Legacy seven-category top-level register is not used by the current route. The guided layer exposes exactly the four adverse factor groups printed in current clause 13.1.
A partial supplied subset can no longer imply Section-13 prevention PASS. Every represented current 13.2 requirement is explicit and conditionally mandatory.
Enhanced NDT is triggered only when tensile weld-zone stress is strictly greater than 0.4Ry; equality does not trigger the printed greater-than condition.
The current 25 mm minimum distance on each side of the splice axis is verified from an explicit provided dimension; geometry is not inferred.
Applicability requires explicit engineering review. A positive conservative screen cannot be suppressed by setting the assessment route false.
Missing through-thickness tensile-test evidence or selected rolled-product Z certificate yields INCOMPLETE_FAIL_CLOSED; neither is inferred from steel grade/designation.
Five printed factors are summed algebraically; printed 0.5/1.1 modifiers are explicit. Selected Z quality must independently satisfy both the minimum Z15/Z25/Z35 route and psi_zr<=psi_zn.
Library search found the current normative source but no dedicated NormCAD Section-13 end-to-end oracle. No synthetic golden case was created.
